// divguard:path ai/openrouter_images.go

package ai

import "strings"

type sseEvent struct{ Event, Data string }

// decodeSSE stands in for the shared decoder in ai/sse.go.
func decodeSSE(frames []sseEvent, emit func(sseEvent)) {
	for _, f := range frames {
		emit(f)
	}
}

// imageMime reads a data: URL, not an SSE line.
func imageMime(imageURL string) string {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(imageURL, "data:") {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.Split(imageURL, ";")[0], "data:")
}
